sub_graphs.description: Models the encoding process for different trie node types

nodes.label: Node Pending Encoding
nodes.description: Trie node ready to be RLP-encoded

nodes.label: Encode Leaf Node
nodes.description: Encode key remainder and value using compact encoding with leaf flag

sub_graphs.title: Prague Trie: Key Hashing and Nibble Conversion
sub_graphs.description: Models the key transformation process including security-related hashing

nodes.label: Raw Key Received
nodes.description: Original key bytes received for trie operation

nodes.label: Hash Key with Keccak-256
nodes.description: Apply keccak256 to key if trie is secured (prevents key grinding)

nodes.label: Convert Bytes to Nibbles
nodes.description: Expand each byte into two 4-bit nibbles for trie traversal

nodes.label: Compact Nibble Encoding
nodes.description: Compress nibbles with parity and leaf/extension flags

nodes.label: Key Secured (Hashed)
nodes.description: Key has been keccak256 hashed for security

nodes.label: Key as Nibble List
nodes.description: Key converted to nibble format for trie traversal

nodes.label: Key Compact Encoded
nodes.description: Nibbles compressed for storage with metadata flags

external_entities.name: Key Provider
external_entities.description: External source providing keys for trie operations (e.g., address, storage slot)

ambiguities.text: The 'secured' flag on Trie determines whether keys are hashed, but the security implications of an unsecured trie are not explicitly stated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume unsecured tries are only used for internal purposes where key grinding attacks are not a concern

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify behavior when patricialize encounters an empty mapping at a non-zero level
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume patricialize returns None for empty mappings, which propagates up as empty subnode references

ambiguities.text: The 32-byte threshold for hash replacement is stated but the rationale (preventing trie inflation) is not documented
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is an optimization to bound trie node sizes and prevent DoS through large inline data

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes attackers cannot find keccak256 collisions to create conflicting trie keys
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Key collisions could overwrite or corrupt state, enabling state manipulation attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT (keccak256 of empty RLP) is a well-known constant that all nodes agree upon
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different empty root values would cause consensus failures during block validation

implicit_assumptions.description: The get_storage_root callback function passed to root() correctly computes storage roots for accounts
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect storage roots would corrupt state root calculation, invalidating blocks

implicit_assumptions.description: Frozen dataclass semantics ensure shallow copy is safe (contents are immutable)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Mutable content could lead to unintended state modifications across trie copies
